defs.def: a unit inside a cell which controls a particular quality in a living thing that has been passed on from its parents 基因

ex.s: This allows the Salk team to determine what genes are most beneficial to their plant designs.
ex.t: 这使 Salk 团队能够确定哪些基因对他们的植物设计最有益。

ex.s: Identify genes for desirable plant roots.
ex.t: 识别理想植物根系所需的基因。

She also said there were likely a number of other genes that help the Bajau dive.
ex.t: 她还说，可能还有若干其他基因帮助巴瑶族潜水。

ex.s: Multiple genes behaved differently, depending on whether someone had eaten or not before walking.
ex.t: 多个基因的表现因人是否在步行前进食而有所不同。

ex.s: These genes were much more active when the men had fasted before exercise than when they had breakfasted.
ex.t: 这些基因在男性运动前禁食时比吃早餐时活跃得多。

ex.s: A workout after breakfast improves gene performances.
ex.t: 早餐后锻炼能改善基因表现。

ex.s: In fact, good friends can share up to 1% of the same genes - as much as we might share with our great-great-great grandparents!
ex.t: 事实上，好朋友可以共享多达1%的相同基因——和我们与曾曾曾祖父母共享的基因一样多！

ex.s: The nucleus of this cell contains all the genes needed to produce a new sheep.
ex.t: 这个细胞的细胞核包含所有繁育一只新羊所需的基因。

ex.s: Longevity is one of the modern world's great successes and science is beginning to find evidence that our genes have a lot to do with whether we will live a longer life.
ex.t: 长寿是现代社会的一大成功，科学开始发现证据表明，我们的基因在很大程度上决定了我们是否能活得更长。

ex.s: Researchers at Harvard Medical School intheUS areconvinced theyhavefound aso called "longevity gene" and are testing whether the addition of this gene to mice extends their lives.
ex.t: 美国哈佛医学院的研究人员确信他们已经找到了所谓的"长寿基因"，并正在测试将这种基因添加到老鼠体内是否能延长它们的寿命。

ex.s: The long-term aim is to find a way of manipulating the gene to add an extra decade or two to human life with gene therapy.
ex.t: 长期目标是找到操纵这种基因的方法，通过基因疗法为人类寿命增加十年或二十年。
